additionalContext: ("Pre-merge hook: PR #" + $n + " is BEHIND with auto-merge armed (GitHub merge state BEHIND or UNKNOWN) and is not in the queue yet; skipped the origin/main sync. This skip is ALSO a refusal when the PR\x5cu0027s base branch has no merge queue or is not a supported branch name (both print the same answer, so this hook cannot tell them apart; read the base with gh pr view " + $n + " --json baseRefName): this hook and the Phase 7 poll\x5cu0027s fallback only merge origin/main, which is wrong for a PR on another base. For such a PR whose base has no merge queue, sync by hand against its own base (git fetch origin <base> && git merge origin/<base>, then push); if that base has a merge queue of its own, the queue makes the PR current and no sync is needed. Either way do NOT disarm and re-arm: disarming makes the next check find the PR disarmed, and this hook then merges origin/main. If the PR is based on main (a merge-queue repo): no sync is needed, the queue makes the PR current itself and a resync push restarts every required check for nothing. Red required check? Push the fix itself, not a resync. Green and never enqueued? Follow plugins/soleur/skills/ship/references/merge-queue-dequeue.md (\x5cu0027Armed and green but never enqueued\x5cu0027). For a main-based PR keep polling for MERGED: the Phase 7 poll\x5cu0027s expiry fallback is the sanctioned sync, and only for a main-based PR, if you truly need a hand sync, disarm first (gh pr merge " + $n + " --disable-auto), sync, then re-arm. A --admin merge bypasses the queue and lands the head as pushed, so a not-up-to-date refusal there is real: gate it with plugins/soleur/scripts/admin-merge-ready.sh.")

additionalContext: ("Pre-merge hook: origin/main moved " + $incoming + " file(s), all disjoint from " + $branch + "\x5cu0027s " + $prfiles + " changed file(s) (delta disjoint) — no sync merge, the head SHA stays put. Under the merge queue an out-of-date branch enqueues fine (`gh pr merge --squash --auto`; the queue builds its own candidate), so do not update-branch, push or --admin a queued PR. Without the queue a non-admin merge may still fail GitHub\x5cu0027s not-up-to-date check: run `gh pr update-branch`, or gate an --admin merge with plugins/soleur/scripts/admin-merge-ready.sh to land the verified head unmodified — the admin path does not exist for a workflow-editing PR." + $qnote)
